document_api_meta.title: Get Order Customs Requirements
document_api_meta.env_desc:
This API is used to query whether an order requires extra customs clearance information, whether such information has been submitted, and the list of submitted customs clearance information.
If extra customs clearance information is required but not yet provided, the merchant must complete and submit it before shipment can proceed.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_body_param.name: order_ids
request_body_param.desc: TikTok Shop order IDs to query. When providing a request body, include 1 to 50 order IDs.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: ^^need_fill_clearance
response_param.desc:
Whether an order needs to fill customs infomation:
- true: The order needs to fill in customs information.
- false: The order does not need to fill in custom information.

response_param.name: ^^already_filled_clearance
response_param.desc: When `need_fill_clearance` is `true`, whether customs clearance information has been submitted for every order line that requires it. This value is `false` when `need_fill_clearance` is `false`.

response_param.name: ^^^is_virtual_unboxing
response_param.desc: Whether this sub order is virtual_unboxing

response_param.name: ^^^is_temporary_listing
response_param.desc: Whether this sub order is temporary_listing

response_param.name: ^^^related_item_detail
response_param.desc: Submitted customs clearance item details for this order line, aggregated by SKU.
